method.identity_reconciliation: The validator records unique existing-registry matches by source website, then canonical name or declared alias. Unmatched source rows remain source-scoped identity candidates; ambiguous and conflicting matches fail.
method.prior_partial_comparison: All 42 existing 2025 company_year rows must reconcile to the source transcription, and every existing exact rank must match the recovered official rank.

limitations: The PDF table is image-rendered, so the earlier text extraction failure was real; visual inspection recovers the table without converting the PDF into machine-native source data.
A ranking row is evidence of inclusion and rank on the 2025 SVDG surface. It is not evidence of operational impact, a government award, investment, control, coordination, or actor-level contact.

The current company_years file and company registry remain unchanged in this bounded recovery. Unresolved source identities and new company rows require explicit case-promotion review rather than silent canonical insertion.
